text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

A four-person panel being all women is unremarkable — in many ministries women are a majority of senior HR and policy staff, so this composition arises frequently by chance. It carries almost no evidentiary weight, and raising it would make you look aggrieved rather than credible, damaging you internally.

Also note the substance: her "leading international projects" may have matched a stated criterion your profile doesn't. Your credentials are strong but not obviously superior for the role as scored.

Do pursue the real issue: the unanswered request. Send a polite written follow-up citing your entitlement to feedback and the scoring breakdown. If the criteria or scores look irregular, that's your actual case — not the panel's sex.
